definitions.explanation: The percentage or proportion of people absent from school, work, or an event. Used in educational, workplace, and statistical contexts.

examples.japanese: このクラスの{欠席率|けっせきりつ}は{低|ひく}い。
examples.english: This class has a low absence rate.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}になると{風邪|かぜ}で{欠席率|けっせきりつ}が{上|あ}がる。
examples.english: The absence rate goes up in winter due to colds.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}は{従業員|じゅうぎょういん}の{欠席率|けっせきりつ}を{減|へ}らすために{健康|けんこう}{管理|かんり}プログラムを{導入|どうにゅう}した。
examples.english: The company introduced a health management program to reduce employee absenteeism.

notes:
Composed of {欠席|けっせき} (absence) and {率|りつ} (rate, ratio). Part of the productive X{率|りつ} pattern used for statistical rates: {出席率|しゅっせきりつ} (attendance rate), {合格率|ごうかくりつ} (pass rate), {離職率|りしょくりつ} (turnover rate), etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {欠席率|けっせきりつ}が{高|たか}い: to have a high absence rate
- {欠席率|けっせきりつ}が{低|ひく}い: to have a low absence rate
- {欠席率|けっせきりつ}を{下|さ}げる: to lower the absence rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {出席率|しゅっせきりつ}: attendance rate — the inverse measure; both are commonly tracked in schools and workplaces
- {欠勤率|けっきんりつ}: absenteeism rate (at work) — specifically for workplace absences, while {欠席率|けっせきりつ} is more general
